bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to retirement; Public Employees Retirement Association; correcting employer failure to record service; requiring the payment of employee and employer contributions on omitted service and extending Rule of 90 eligibility for an eligible employee.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+CONTRIBUTIONS FOR ELIGIBLE EMPLOYEE. +]

[+(a) Pursuant to Minnesota Statutes, section 353.27, subdivision 12b, Alaine Pappin and Independent School District No. 281, Robbinsdale, on behalf of Alaine Pappin, must make contributions as calculated under paragraph (d) for service as an eligible employee prior to July 1, 1989, which was previously unreported. +]

[+(b) The contributions described in paragraph (a) are permitted although Alaine Pappin was not enrolled as a member in a public pension plan at the time the service was provided. +]

[+(c) The contributions described in paragraph (a) are sufficient to retroactively establish Alaine Pappin's membership in a public pension fund listed in section 356.30, subdivision 3, and eligibility for an unreduced early retirement benefit under section 354.44. +]

[+(d) The Public Employees Retirement Association must calculate the amount of the contributions required under section 353.27, subdivision 12b, plus interest, based on the omitted salary of $3,185. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to retirement; Public Employees Retirement Association; correcting employer failure to record service; requiring the payment of employee and employer contributions on omitted service and extending Rule of 90 eligibility for an eligible employee.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. CONTRIBUTIONS FOR ELIGIBLE EMPLOYEE.

(a) Pursuant to Minnesota Statutes, section 353.27, subdivision 12b, Alaine Pappin and Independent School District No. 281, Robbinsdale, on behalf of Alaine Pappin, must make contributions as calculated under paragraph (d) for service as an eligible employee prior to July 1, 1989, which was previously unreported.

(b) The contributions described in paragraph (a) are permitted although Alaine Pappin was not enrolled as a member in a public pension plan at the time the service was provided.

(c) The contributions described in paragraph (a) are sufficient to retroactively establish Alaine Pappin's membership in a public pension fund listed in section 356.30, subdivision 3, and eligibility for an unreduced early retirement benefit under section 354.44.

(d) The Public Employees Retirement Association must calculate the amount of the contributions required under section 353.27, subdivision 12b, plus interest, based on the omitted salary of $3,185.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: (a) Pursuant to Minnesota Statutes, section 353.27, subdivision 12b, Alaine Pappin and Independent School District No. 281, Robbinsdale, on behalf of Alaine Pappin, must make contributions as calculated under paragraph (d) for service as an eligible employee prior to July 1, 1989, which was previously unreported.
(b) The contributions described in paragraph (a) are permitted although Alaine Pappin was not enrolled as a member in a public pension plan at the time the service was provided.

(c) The contributions described in paragraph (a) are sufficient to retroactively establish Alaine Pappin's membership in a public pension fund listed in section 356.30, subdivision 3, and eligibility for an unreduced early retirement benefit under section 354.44.
(d) The Public Employees Retirement Association must calculate the amount of the contributions required under section 353.27, subdivision 12b, plus interest, based on the omitted salary of $3,185.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
